theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.29%) and Technology (+1.12%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.52%) and Communication Svcs (-0.96%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.09%, defensives -0.70%, and value/cyclicals -0.48% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.33%, Dow -0.34%, Nasdaq -0.39% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.65%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 6.98% to 18.70, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.63% to $3,915.70, crude oil was little changed at $88.35, and bitcoin slipped 0.53% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
